content.text:
Updated the sales-dashboard package to match all 10 sections of `SPEC.md`. Conversion rates now count only `True` as converted, pooled rates weight each session equally, and campaign summaries use calendar-day windows. The log parser handles all three conversion values, skips blank and comment lines, and reports malformed records with their original line numbers. Deduplication keeps the last record for each ID.

The full spec review also corrected group ranking, per-group rates, and conversion streaks. I updated the README API list and added regression tests for `None` conversion values, duplicate IDs, and other edge cases.

Verified with `python -m pytest`: **22 tests passed**.
